# PhysicsPointInside 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsPointInside:Int32 x:Float32, y:Float32, z:Float32, mask_low:Int32=-1, mask_high:Int32=-1, sensors:Int32=0, world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Float32 | required | The point, x. |
| `y` | In | Float32 | required | The point, y. |
| `z` | In | Float32 | required | The point, z. |
| `mask_low` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers to look at, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask (bit n is layer n). -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `mask_high` | In | Int32 | `-1` | The layers 32 to 63, as bits 0 to 31 of a mask. -1 (default) looks at all layers. |
| `sensors` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 also finds sensors (see `PhysicsSensor`); 0 (default) leaves them out. |
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

**Returns:** The entity of a body that contains the point, or 0 if there is none.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Finds out which body of a physics world contains a point of the world. If several do, the one that was made first is returned. With sensors included this is how a region that does something once something is in it (a trigger volume) is asked.

The body is kept for `GetPhysicsHitEntity`; the point is `GetPhysicsHitX`, `GetPhysicsHitY` and `GetPhysicsHitZ`, and the normal and the distance are 0.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
